messages:
maya: Heads up — staging promote blocked by CI. Matrix job node-install on node-14/ubuntu failed with git-lfs fetch timeout; also docker push to our registry getting 429/backoff. deploy-bot auto-paused the promote.

deploy-bot: auto-pause: canary promote paused due to failing pipelines (rule: upstream-ci-fail). See: https://ci.redwood.example/1234

stuart: I'm on it. grabbing logs now.

jen: which job id? I can check registry logs for the 429s.

maya: job: pipeline/6789 (matrix axis: node=14, region=eu-west). tail of failing step:
```
Fetching submodules with git-lfs...
Git LFS: (0 of 3 files) 0 B / 84.3 MB
error: RPC failed; curl 28 Transfer timed out
fatal: git-lfs filter-process: exit status 128
```

jen: Ugh, git-lfs timeouts again. We saw this last month with large model artifacts in tests.

ops-sre: registry shows a burst of 429s from our staging runners at 2026-03-21T09:12Z — likely rate-limited by the cloud registry. Backoff header set to 30s.

karim: Proposed options:
1) pin promote to last-green image (sha: sha256:abc123) and manual promote
2) retry pipeline with reduced concurrency and `GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1` in install step then fetch artifacts later
3) wait until registry clears (30–90m) and retry

stuart: I can do (2) quickly and run a constrained matrix (concurrency=2) to see if git-lfs completes.

maya: Need decision for release window in 45m. If we can't get CI green in 30m, prefer pin to last-green and cut a patch release later.

jen: I'll try to clear some registry quota by pausing nonessential pushes (infra job) — give me 5m.

deploy-bot: manual action required to unpause promote: `/deploybot resume staging-canary --manual` — current state: paused

maya: Ok action plan: jen will throttle pushes, stuart will rerun constrained matrix, if still failing in 20m we pin to sha256:abc123 and proceed. I'll update release notes and notify PMs. :thumbsup:

karim: noted. I'll prepare the rollback/pin PR just in case.

maya: thanks — marking this thread for follow-up in release notes.
